title: A shorthand tag suffix cannot contain an exclamation mark
notes: Tag characters exclude `!` (production 40), so `!a!b!c` is neither a handle followed by a suffix nor a primary tag with a suffix: the second `!` after the handle `!a!` cannot belong. The handle is also not declared. Either reason makes it an error, so no position is stated.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted `!a!b!c` as a tag with the suffix `b!c`.
